name: button-group
title: Button group
description: Groups related buttons into one control, or joins a main action with its options as a split button.

name: button
title: Button
description: Starts an action on this page or submits a form.

name: close-button
title: Close button
description: The icon-only button that closes a dialog, sheet, banner or panel, named "Close" in the current language.

name: copy-button
title: Copy button
description: Copies a value to the clipboard; the icon turns into a check and a status says it was copied.

name: fab
title: Floating action button
description: Keeps one task reachable over scrolling content, as a button or a link, collapsing to its icon on phones.

name: language-switcher
title: Language switcher
description: Picks the interface language: each option named in the current language and sorted by that name, with an optional mark (a flag, a code chip) supplied by the app.

name: link
title: Link
description: Text that goes to another page, inline in running text or as a standalone subtle link.

name: pressable
title: Pressable
description: A Box that is a button or a link as a whole, for custom tiles and rows.

name: theme-switcher
title: Theme switcher
description: Lets people choose system, light or dark theme, stored per device and applied before first paint.

name: toggle-button
title: Toggle button
description: A button that stays pressed or not, alone or in a group where one or several options are on.

name: area-chart
title: Area chart
description: A value over time as filled areas, one or several series, with a legend, tooltip and data table.

name: bar-chart
title: Bar chart
description: Values per category or period as bars, grouped or stacked, vertical or horizontal.

name: bar-list
title: Bar list
description: A ranked list of names with values and proportional bars; names may link.

name: calendar-heatmap
title: Calendar heatmap
description: A value per day over weeks, as shaded cells in a calendar grid.

name: chart-parts
title: Chart parts
description: The shared frame (with its data table), legend and tooltip the charts are built from, plus the CHART_COLORS series palette, for a custom chart.

name: composed-chart
title: Composed chart
description: Bars and lines on one plot, with an optional second value axis, for a figure and its rate.

name: donut-chart
title: Donut chart
description: Parts of a whole, two to five, with the total in the center and exact shares; more parts fold into "Other".

name: funnel-chart
title: Funnel chart
description: Steps of a process with how many reach each one and the conversion between them.

name: gauge-chart
title: Gauge chart
description: One value against its range and an optional target, as a half ring.

name: heatmap
title: Heatmap
description: A value by two cyclic dimensions, such as weekday by hour, as shaded cells.

name: line-chart
title: Line chart
description: Up to five series over time as lines, for comparing trends.

name: radar-chart
title: Radar chart
description: A few items scored on the same axes, as overlapping polygons.

name: radial-chart
title: Radial chart
description: Progress of a few parts as concentric rings.

name: scatter-chart
title: Scatter chart
description: Points on two value axes, for seeing a relation and outliers.

name: sparkline
title: Sparkline
description: A tiny line or bar trend with no axes, next to a figure.

name: tracker
title: Tracker
description: A row of status blocks, one per day or check, for uptime or completion.

name: data-table
title: Data table
description: A Table with a toolbar: search, filters, a column picker, bulk actions, paging or virtualization, and its view kept in the URL.

name: grid-list
title: Grid list
description: A list to move through with arrow keys and select from: rows with a visual, a title and status (`layout="stack"`), or tiles in a responsive grid with actions and drag to reorder (`layout="grid"`).

name: table
title: Table
description: Records people scan, compare, sort and act on: sortable columns, row selection by checkbox, a row that opens its record.

name: tree
title: Tree
description: A hierarchy to browse: folders and files, categories, with nodes that open and close.

name: color-field
title: Color field
description: A hex color typed with a live swatch; a malformed value stays as typed with an example of a valid one.

name: color-picker
title: Color picker
description: A saturation-brightness area, hue (and alpha) sliders, a hex field and a two-theme preview of the primary button with its contrast.

name: color-swatch-picker
title: Color swatch picker
description: Preset colors as named swatches, optionally ending with a button that opens a color picker for a custom color.

name: color-swatch
title: Color swatch
description: One named color tile with a faint inset edge, so light colors show on light grounds.

name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: A month grid to pick a date or a range, with markers, unavailable days and several visible months.

name: date-field
title: Date field
description: A typed date (or date and time) in the locale's order, with min/max and month-day mode.

name: date-picker
title: Date picker
description: A date field with a calendar popover, Today and Clear actions, markers and unavailable days.

name: time-field
title: Time field
description: A typed time in the locale's clock, with minute steps and an optional time zone.

name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: A person or a company shown by photo, initials or icon, alone or in a stacked group.

name: badge
title: Badge
description: A short label beside content: a record's status in a pill (subtle or bold), a live state as a dot and a word, or a count.

name: card
title: Card
description: A surface that groups related content about one object, optionally a link or a button as a whole.

name: carousel
title: Carousel
description: Pages through a set of images with previous/next and optional thumbnails; never auto-advances.

name: description-list
title: Description list
description: Labeled facts about one record, in rows or stacked columns; empty values read as "Not set", and a value may be copyable.

name: heading
title: Heading
description: A page or section title on the type scale, with its HTML level separate from its size.

name: icon
title: Icon
description: Draws any Lucide icon by name, sized and colored with theme tokens.

name: image-viewer
title: Image viewer
description: A full-screen dark lightbox with previous/next that cycle, arrow keys, a position caption and a filmstrip.

name: image
title: Image
description: A picture in a box that keeps its shape while it loads, with a fallback when it cannot load.

name: kbd
title: Kbd
description: A keyboard key or shortcut shown as a keycap in help text, menus and tooltips.

name: separator
title: Separator
description: A thin line between groups that spacing alone does not separate, optionally with a short label.

name: stat
title: Stat
description: A key figure with its label, an optional change against a named period and a sparkline.

name: text
title: Text
description: Body copy, captions and inline text on the type scale, plus Prose for long rich text.

name: timeline
title: Timeline
description: A record's history grouped by day, with icons, tones and recent events in relative time.

name: visually-hidden
title: Visually hidden
description: Text that screen readers read but the page does not show.

name: banner
title: Banner
description: A message about the page or the whole app, inline or floating, in an information, warning, danger or success tone.

name: empty-state
title: Empty state
description: Explains why a view has no content or failed to load, and offers the action that changes that.

name: meter
title: Meter
description: A segmented gauge for a quantity within a known range, with warning and danger thresholds.

name: progress
title: Progress
description: Shows how far a task has got, as a bar or a circle, determinate or indeterminate.

name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: Placeholder shapes in the layout of content that is still loading.

name: spinner
title: Spinner
description: A small indeterminate loading indicator.

name: field
title: Field
description: A label, hint and error row around any control, wired for screen readers; plus the label, description and error parts.

name: file-upload
title: File upload
description: Pick files with a button or by dropping them, validate size and type, and show each file with its progress or error.

name: form
title: Form
description: A form with consistent rhythm, sections with legends, side-by-side rows and a footer for its actions.

name: image-cropper
title: Image cropper
description: Frames one picked image to the shape a surface needs: pan, zoom, rotate, an aspect preset, and the output as a file.

name: input-group
title: Input group
description: Joins an input with addons (text, icons) and actions (buttons) into one bordered control.

name: input
title: Input
description: One text-entry field with a label, description and error; `type` picks text, email, url, password, search, number or tel.

name: otp-field
title: One-time code
description: Boxes for a one-time verification code, with paste, autofill and a resend cooldown.

name: text-area
title: Text area
description: A multi-line text input that grows with its content, with an optional character count.

name: box
title: Box
description: A container with token-only padding, background, radius, border and shadow.

name: grid
title: Grid
description: Equal columns, fixed or auto-fit to a minimum width, with a token gap.

name: scroll-area
title: Scroll area
description: A region that scrolls inside a height limit with thin themed scrollbars, keyboard reachable.

name: section
title: Section
description: Full-width page bands with a centered container; the heading that names a band is yours.

name: split
title: Split
description: Panes side by side that stack below a width of the layout itself: split screens, list and detail, media and text.

name: stack
title: Stack
description: Stacks children vertically with a token gap.

name: toolbar
title: Toolbar
description: A row of controls above a list or table; BulkBar shows actions for the selected rows.

name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: Sections that expand and collapse; Disclosure is a single expandable section.

name: bottom-nav
title: Bottom navigation
description: A bottom tab bar for phones with four or five top destinations and badges.

name: breadcrumbs
title: Breadcrumbs
description: Shows where a page sits in a hierarchy, collapsing middle levels into a menu when long.

name: navbar
title: Navbar
description: The top bar of a public site: brand, up to five links, actions and a language choice, collapsing into a menu on phones.

name: page-header
title: Page header
description: An app page's header bar: menu button on small screens, the page title and its actions.

name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: Moves through pages of results with page numbers, previous/next and a page-size choice.

name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
description: The main navigation of an app: brand, sections with nested items and badges, a pinned footer, collapsible to icons.

name: skip-link
title: Skip link
description: The first focusable element of a page, visible on focus, that jumps to the main content.

name: stepper
title: Stepper
description: Shows progress through a multi-step flow or checklist, with done, current, waiting and failed steps.

name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Switches between views of the same content; SegmentedControl switches a small set of options inline.

name: alert-dialog
title: Alert dialog
description: Asks people to confirm or cancel one consequential action, optionally by typing a confirmation.

name: command
title: Command
description: A ⌘K search over actions and records, with recent items, groups and server results.

name: context-menu
title: Context menu
description: The actions for what is under the pointer, opened by a right-click, a long press or Shift+F10.

name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: A modal window for a focused task, with a title, body and footer actions, in small to full-screen sizes.

name: drawer
title: Drawer
description: A panel that slides in from the side, or a bottom sheet on phones, for detail and edit views beside the page.

name: hover-card
title: Hover card
description: A preview card that opens when the pointer rests on its trigger or the trigger gets keyboard focus.

name: menu
title: Menu
description: A list of actions under a button, with sections, icons, shortcuts and disabled items that say why.

name: popover
title: Popover
description: Non-modal content anchored to a trigger: extra detail, a small form, a picker.

name: toast
title: Toast
description: Brief messages about what just happened, with one optional action; call toast() anywhere under the provider.

name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A short hint for a control on hover and keyboard focus, and on tap for touch users when needed.

name: tour
title: Tour
description: A guided tour: a short sequence of steps, each pointing at a part of the page with a title, a sentence and Back, Next and Done.

name: autocomplete
title: Autocomplete
description: Free text with suggestions loaded as people type, grouped and with detail lines.

name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: A box to turn one option on or off, or a group of boxes for several options.

name: combobox
title: Combo box
description: Type to filter a long list and pick one or several items, with load-more and app-side results.

name: list-box
title: List box
description: A list of options shown in place, not in a dropdown: pick one or several.

name: radio
title: Radio group
description: One choice from a few options that all stay visible.

name: select
title: Select
description: Pick one option from a short list in a dropdown, with groups, descriptions and icons.

name: slider
title: Slider
description: Picks a value or a range by dragging along a track, with locale-formatted output.

name: switch
title: Switch
description: Turns a setting on or off immediately.

name: tag-group
title: Tag group
description: A group of tags that can be removed or selected: features, filters, keywords.
